## DepositAmountArgs type

Enforces that at least one deposit amount source is provided.

- `amount` alone: standard ERC20 deposit. - `nativeAmount` alone: pure native-wrap deposit (vault asset must be wNative). - Both: mixed deposit (ERC20 transfer + native wrap).

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type DepositAmountArgs = {
    amount: bigint;
    nativeAmount?: bigint;
} | {
    nativeAmount: bigint;
    amount?: bigint;
};
```
